'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Fine Gael leadership election]]
**[[Leo Varadkar]] announces his resignation as [[Taoiseach]] and [[leader of Fine Gael|leader]] of [[Fine Gael]], triggering a leadership election. Varadkar will remain as Taoiseach until his successor as party leader is elected. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/20/europe/leo-varadkar-ireland-prime-minister-resignation-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Indonesian general election]]
**The [[General Elections Commission]] announces that [[Prabowo Subianto]] had received the most votes in the [[2024 Indonesian presidential election|presidential election]], but the determination of the winner as president-elect is still waiting complaints from other candidates at the [[Constitutional Court of Indonesia|Constitutional Court]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/20/indonesia-election-commission-confirms-prabowo-subianto-wins-presidency (Al Jazeera)]
